This is jumpdest analysis attack. The old benchmark was wrong so I updated it. Amsterdam makes it actually a bit easier because you can pre-pay the CREATE cost. but how much gas limit do you need to push these? I mean in Gloas we have a hard limit: if payloads take longer than 6 seconds to execute we are literally fucked So such payload must not exist I think someone should do proper measurements on devnet. I only took numbers from dora. The benchmark are here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3631. Or you can just poke the already deployed contract: 0x2802328e49ea4b91714f5547a8288a651086c22e with high gas empty transactions.
